method: constant GPU average power across the entire simulated combined-g interval
measurement_workload: compiled pi0.5 synthetic physical MHA8, VLM and AE on GPU in serial
use_as: proxy for GPU average power in method g; this is not a VLM-only power measurement
application_interval: full combined-g epoch; no additional duty factor or GPU idle term
user_preference: GPU average power is sufficient for this estimate
